content.rendered: Afternoon bus Route #18 departed Middleton late due to mechanical issues that were quickly repaired while students waited on the school lawn with staff supervision.   Once repaired the students were transported home and will be arriving soon.  Please contact the school office if you have further questions.  (503) 825-5300.  We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused your families and schedules
